subject: QBR: Field sprint — pipeline consolidation & account opposition matrix
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-07-05T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR: Field sprint — pipeline consolidation & account opposition matrix

Team —

We need a concise, account-by-account rollup for Acme ahead of the QBR workshop on Friday. I'm attaching an initial heatmap and a one-pager pack. Primary asks:

1) Verify runway and close dates for all open opportunities in the attached spreadsheet (sheet: ACME_OPPS). Highlight any that moved >1 month in the last 2 weeks.
2) For each top-8 account line item, add an "opposition matrix" row with: competitor, primary risk, required decision maker, and necessary technical artifact (e.g., SOC2 evidence, private VPC blueprint).
3) Confirm forecast category (commit/probable/commit w/ risk) and provide a recommended up/down motion for the consolidated forecast column.

Please use the shared Drive folder link in related links and update the Account_Synopses_v2.pdf with your notes (editor comments). Target: consolidated forecast deck + 8 account one-pagers by Thursday EOD so we can synthesize for Friday's leadership readout.

Attachments: QBR_account_heatmap.xlsx (spreadsheet), Account_Synopses_v2.pdf (one-pagers), mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (template)

Thanks — markus

Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-07-06T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: Field sprint — pipeline consolidation & account opposition matrix

Markus — thanks, got it. Quick notes from my side after a first pass through ACME_OPPS:

- Opportunity: ACME Enterprise (Opportunity #3421) — moved from FYQ3 target to FYQ4 last Friday after procurement delay. Probable; recommend move to "commit w/ risk" until PO in hand. I added a comment row in the spreadsheet with the procurement contact (Jamie O'Neill).
- Opportunity: Analytics Platform Add-on — strong technical fit but "opposition": their incumbent (BigCloud) has a seat at the table; risk = entrenched discounting. Recommended action: schedule a 45m joint-POC with Product and Solutions Engineering next week.
- I've started the opposition matrix for the top 6 accounts in the heatmap (sheet: OPPOSITION_MATRIX) — left a TODO cell for required technical artifact for two accounts where Security has outstanding asks.

I'll own synthesis for the "up/down motion" recommendations and will post a consolidated forecast delta by Wednesday COB.

Tessa
Director, Field Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jamie O'Neill <jamie.oneill@acme.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acme.com
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-07-06T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: Field sprint — pipeline consolidation & account opposition matrix

Markus/Tessa — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. A few clarifications from the customer side before you finalize: 

- For ACME Enterprise #3421: procurement did indeed shift timelines; we now have a June 2028 preferred start (internal reasons). We will still aim to finalize T&C/PO by end of July but can't promise. Please keep that as "probable" unless PO confirmed.
- On the Analytics Platform Add-on: BigCloud is pushing a bundled renew + discount. Their team is also asking for a SOC 2 in-scope attestation before moving to a pilot. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a scoped SOC 2 artifact (redacted) by next Tuesday? If not, this will likely shift to BigCloud.
- Attached a small operations note: "ops_acme_integration_notes.txt" with the list of technical stakeholders and their weekly sync cadence.

If you want, we can slot a 30m call with their security lead on Monday to clarify the SOC 2 ask — let me know preferred times.

Best,
Jamie O'Neill
Head of Platform Partnerships, Acme Analytics
jamie.oneill@acme.com

Attachments referenced: ops_acme_integration_notes.txt

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-07-07T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR: Field sprint — pipeline consolidation & account opposition matrix

Good context — thanks Jamie and Tessa. Actions and owners (short):

1) Tessa: finalize opposition matrix and recommended up/down motions for the consolidated forecast. Deliverable: one-slide forecast delta (sheet: CONSOLIDATED_FORECAST) by Thursday EOD.
2) Aditya: validate SOC2 artifact availability with Security & Compliance and confirm by EOD tomorrow whether we can provide a redacted attestation to Acme. If yes, add note to the spreadsheet and to the mutual_action_plan_draft.docx; if no, propose the alternative (security sandbox + SOC2 roadmap).
3) Laura: prepare the 8 one-pagers with the updated runway/owner notes and include a short "ask" for leadership per account. Use the Account_Synopses_v2.pdf; mark changes with comments.
4) Markus: I'll schedule a 30m prep session with Product and Solutions Eng for Monday 11:00am PT to prep the joint-POC talking points.

Next steps: Tessa, Aditya, Laura — can each reply with a 1-line status update by EOD tomorrow so I can aggregate for the leadership pre-brief? Jamie — appreciate the ops note; please also share the preferred Monday window for the security sync if possible.

Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
